This allows PostHog to handle Graph API responses that return a single object without pagination, while retaining pagination support for other endpoints

observations.behavior: Adds comprehensive unit tests for Meta Ads warehouse ingestion, including schema endpoint coverage, breakdown dimension primary key and field exclusion, request windowing, and single-object endpoint handling.
observations.posthog_connection: These checks prevent warehouse ingestion failures and duplicate rows by ensuring breakdown dimensions are not omitted from primary keys and are not requested as fields, and that requests include time windows and account for single-object endpoints.
